value.rationale: The 2026 map introduces extinction/tricritical analytic thresholds but uses period-doubling regime plots for the active branch. The theorem supplies an exact first active fixed-point flip boundary uniformly in two ecological parameters, an exact physical-validity guarantee, exclusion of subcritical flips throughout the nonnegative-growth wedge, a near-onset cycle-amplitude coefficient and an exact critical slowdown constant. These quantify a meaningful local oscillation boundary rather than a generic restatement of the scalar normal form; global and strong-Allee regimes are outside scope.
